changes.title: House censures Rep. Chuck Edwards over "inappropriate conduct" toward aides
changes.summary: The House Ethics Committee detailed the North Carolina Republican's "unprofessional and inappropriate conduct" toward two young women who worked for him.

changes.title: North Carolina Rep. Chuck Edwards is formally censured over harassment allegations
changes.summary: The censure vote drew bipartisan support, and followed an investigation by the House Ethics Committee into allegations of sexual harassment against two young female staff members. (Image credit: Allison Robbert).

changes.title: North Carolina GOP chooses replacement candidate for Rep. Chuck Edwards
changes.summary: State Rep. Jennifer Balkcom will face Jamie Ager on the ballot in November.

changes.title: N.C. GOP committee picks Jennifer Balkcom to replace Rep. Chuck Edwards on November ballot
changes.summary: Edwards dropped his re-election bid after the House Ethics Committee recommended he be censured over sexual harassment allegations. He has denied any wrongdoing.
